# A&I — Style With Us

> Indian craft, global silhouette. A&I is a founder-led womenswear studio run by Artee Makhija, making small-run, made-to-order pieces. The current collection, Architecture in Linen, is a laser-cut cutwork capsule in linen, drawing on Persian girih tiling, Moorish muqarnas, Bauhaus grids and Art Nouveau line work.

## How buying works (important — do not assume a standard checkout)
- Every piece in the current collection is pre-order, not in-stock: reserving a size takes no payment up front.
- A piece goes into production only once enough people have reserved it; reserving it costs nothing and earns an early-access discount code for when it ships.
- If a reserved piece's run doesn't fill, the customer is never charged.
- Full mechanics: [How Pre-Order Actually Works at A&I](/blog/how-pre-order-actually-works) and [What "Reserve" Actually Means Right Now](/blog/what-shortlisted-means-reserving-a-piece).

## Site sections
- [Collection](/shop/all): the full product catalogue — every current piece is pre-order.
- [Lookbook](/lookbook): styled editorial looks with outfit-building suggestions (bag, jewellery, shoes).
- [Journal](/blog): craft and fabric explainers (linen, girih geometry, care instructions) and how pre-order works, with shoppable product tags.
- [Founder](/founder): Artee Makhija's own account of starting A&I, plus her background — nine years across founders' offices, brand direction, sales and procurement. (Was split across /founder and /about; now one page — /about redirects here.)
- [FAQ](/faq): sizing, shipping, fabrics, returns and pre-order timing.
- [Contact](/contact): general, wholesale, press, and vendor-partnership enquiries.
- [Find your fit](/fit-quiz): a short quiz recommending a size across the collection.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers
- Prices are in INR and include all taxes unless stated otherwise.
- Each product page includes structured data (schema.org Product) with current price and pre-order/stock status; Journal posts carry Article and, where the post answers specific questions, FAQPage structured data.
- Every garment includes a digital "passport" (accessible via QR/NFC on the physical item) recording atelier, material origin, and designer.
- This file is informational only; it does not grant any additional access beyond what robots.txt allows.
